name: Bergen Town Center
summary: Bergen Town Center is a distinctive outlet mall in Paramus featuring popular apparel brands and department stores alongside essential anchors like Whole Foods and Target. With diverse dining options and a convenient location in Bergen County's premier shopping district, it offers both value-oriented outlet shopping and everyday retail needs in one destination.
demographics: Bergen Town Center attracts a diverse, middle to upper-middle income demographic from the densely populated Bergen County area, with household incomes typically ranging from $75,000 to $150,000+. The primary trade area draws heavily from families and working professionals aged 25-54 who value the convenience of outlet pricing combined with everyday essentials like groceries from Whole Foods and Target. The center serves a multicultural customer base reflective of northern New Jersey's diversity, with shoppers seeking both value-oriented outlet deals and quality lifestyle amenities in a single destination.
description: Bergen Town Center in Paramus, New Jersey, stands as a unique hybrid shopping destination that combines the value proposition of an outlet mall with the convenience of everyday retail essentials. Located in the heart of Bergen County's renowned retail corridor, this shopping center offers visitors access to popular apparel brands and department stores at outlet prices, while also housing essential anchors like Whole Foods Market and Target that serve the daily needs of local residents. The center's diverse tenant mix creates a one-stop shopping experience where bargain hunters can score deals on fashion and home goods, then pick up organic groceries or household necessities without making multiple stops. With a strong 4.5-star rating from over 13,000 reviews, Bergen Town Center has earned its reputation as a reliable shopping destination that balances value, variety, and convenience. The property's restaurant offerings provide dining options that transform a simple shopping trip into a more leisurely outing, making it a popular choice for both locals and visitors exploring Paramus's famous tax-free shopping district.
